name: follies
title: Follies
description: The Follies engine, framework-free: seeded surreal architecture in cloud banks, drawn as SVG strings on a server, at build time or in the browser. folly({ template, seed }) draws a scene (the city, a window, a medallion, a band, the arcade wall, a doorway, a procession, a skyline, an observatory, a stage); drawing({ object, seed }) draws one object from a library of architecture, sky, instruments, gardens, travel, the stage and everyday moments; every fill is a colourway role.

// The city: the hero's whole scene, at the triptych's density.
import { box, DEPTH, observatory, steps } from "./buildings"
import { pinwheelArch, plant } from "./plants"
import { cloudBank } from "./clouds"
import { circle, scatter, shape } from "./motifs"
import { arcade } from "./parts"
import { el, rs } from "./svg"
import type { Scene } from "./scene"

const mirror = (w: number, flip: boolean, svg: string) =>
  flip ? el("g", { transform: `translate(${w} 0) scale(-1 1)` }, svg) : svg

/** The city: cloud strata, a sun, an arcade, a tower with an observatory, a pinwheel block, a stair, plants, clouds. */
export const city: Scene = {
  w: 1200,
  h: 560,
  fit: "xMidYMax slice",
  body: (p, seed) => {
    const [W, ground] = [1200, 640]
    const r = (k: string) => rs(seed, k)
    const [sun, sky, tw, bk] = [r("sun"), r("sky"), r("tower"), r("block")]
    const arc = arcade(p, r("arcade"), {
      x0: r("arcade-x").between(50, 110),
      top: r("arcade-y").between(250, 285),
      ground,
    })
    const [tx, tWidth, ty] = [
      tw.between(820, 870),
      tw.between(150, 175),
      tw.between(285, 325),
    ]
    const bx = Math.min(tx - 190, Math.max(arc.x1 - 40, bk.between(560, 620)))
    const by = bk.between(350, 380)
    const scene =
      shape(
        p,
        circle(
          sun.between(170, 300),
          sun.between(140, 175),
          sun.between(68, 88),
        ),
        "sun",
      ) +
      scatter(p, sky, {
        x0: 30,
        y0: 60,
        x1: 1170,
        y1: 230,
        sparkles: 7,
        rings: 5,
        dots: 9,
      }) +
      cloudBank(p, r("strata-a"), {
        x0: -20,
        x1: sky.between(380, 480),
        base: 322,
        top: 262,
        rmin: 18,
        rmax: 32,
        fill: "paper",
        floating: true,
      }) +
      cloudBank(p, r("strata-b"), {
        x0: sky.between(680, 760),
        x1: W + 20,
        base: 292,
        top: 236,
        rmin: 16,
        rmax: 30,
        fill: "paper",
        floating: true,
      }) +
      (tw.chance(0.6)
        ? box(p, {
            x: tx + tWidth + 26,
            y: ty + 90,
            w: 84,
            h: ground - ty - 90,
            fill: "tone-2",
            windows: 2,
          })
        : "") +
      box(p, {
        x: tx,
        y: ty,
        w: tWidth,
        h: ground - ty,
        fill: "tone-1",
        windows: 3,
      }) +
      observatory(p, tw, {
        cx: tx + tWidth / 2,
        base: ty + DEPTH[1] * 0.5,
        rad: tWidth * 0.42,
        fill: "plane-2",
      }) +
      arc.svg +
      cloudBank(p, r("mid"), {
        x0: 0,
        x1: W,
        base: ground,
        top: r("mid-top").between(405, 430),
        rmin: 32,
        rmax: 60,
        fill: "paper",
      }) +
      box(p, { x: bx, y: by, w: 190, h: ground - by, fill: "tone-3" }) +
      pinwheelArch(p, {
        x: bx + 34,
        base: by + 178,
        w: 122,
        h: 150,
        frame: "leaf",
        colour: "bloom",
      }) +
      steps(p, {
        x0: bx - 8,
        y0: 580,
        x1: bx - 8 - r("steps").between(230, 270),
        y1: arc.top,
        count: r("steps").int(11, 14),
        fill: "stair",
        depth: 2,
      }) +
      cloudBank(p, r("front"), {
        x0: 0,
        x1: W,
        base: ground,
        top: r("front-top").between(492, 512),
        rmin: 28,
        rmax: 56,
        fill: "cloud",
      }) +
      plant(p, r("plant-a"), {
        x: r("plant-a").between(70, 150),
        ground: 552,
        height: 250,
        blooms: 2,
      }) +
      plant(p, r("plant-b"), {
        x: r("plant-b").between(1050, 1140),
        ground: 552,
        height: 220,
        blooms: 1,
      }) +
      scatter(p, r("low"), {
        x0: 260,
        y0: 518,
        x1: 940,
        y1: 548,
        sparkles: 3,
        rings: 2,
        dots: 4,
        size: [7, 11],
      })
    return mirror(W, r("layout").chance(0.5), scene)
  },
}

// Composed scenes, continued: the observatory platform and the stage in the clouds.
import { cloudBank } from "./clouds"
import { scatter } from "./motifs"
import { OBJECTS, put } from "./objects"
import { slab } from "./objects/forms"
import type { Scene } from "./scene"
import { rs } from "./svg"

/** An observatory: a telescope on a round platform on the clouds, a ringed planet and the moon above, a constellation. */
export const observatoryScene: Scene = {
  w: 800,
  h: 720,
  fit: "xMidYMax meet",
  body: (p, seed) => {
    const r = rs(seed, "observatory")
    const scope = OBJECTS["great-telescope"] ?? OBJECTS["telescope"]
    const planet = OBJECTS["ringed-planet"]
    const moon = OBJECTS["crescent-moon"]
    const stars = OBJECTS["constellation"]
    const plant = OBJECTS["cypress"] ?? OBJECTS["palm"]
    return (
      (stars
        ? put(p, seed, stars, { x: 40, y: 260, h: 220, key: "stars" })
        : "") +
      (planet
        ? put(p, seed, planet, {
            x: r.between(480, 540),
            y: 250,
            h: 210,
            key: "planet",
          })
        : "") +
      (moon
        ? put(p, seed, moon, { x: 300, y: 150, h: 110, key: "moon" })
        : "") +
      scatter(p, rs(seed, "observatory-sky"), {
        x0: 20,
        y0: 20,
        x1: 780,
        y1: 300,
        sparkles: 4,
        rings: 3,
        dots: 6,
      }) +
      (plant
        ? put(p, seed, plant, { x: 90, y: 660, h: 340, key: "plant" })
        : "") +
      slab(p, { cx: 450, y: 566, rx: 200, thick: 26, fill: "platform" }) +
      (scope
        ? put(p, seed, scope, { x: 250, y: 580, h: 460, key: "scope" })
        : "") +
      cloudBank(p, rs(seed, "observatory-clouds"), {
        x0: 20,
        x1: 780,
        base: 712,
        top: 600,
        rmin: 26,
        rmax: 44,
        fill: "paper",
        floating: true,
      })
    )
  },
}

/** A stage on the clouds: a poster column, a spotlight raking across it, speakers and a microphone, sparkles above. */
export const stageScene: Scene = {
  w: 800,
  h: 600,
  fit: "xMidYMax meet",
  body: (p, seed) => {
    const r = rs(seed, "stage")
    const column = OBJECTS["advertising-column"]
    const light = OBJECTS["spotlight"]
    const speakers = OBJECTS["speaker-stack"]
    const mic = OBJECTS["microphone"]
    const sun = OBJECTS["sun-rays"]
    return (
      (sun
        ? put(p, seed, sun, {
            x: r.between(420, 520),
            y: 260,
            h: 220,
            key: "sun",
          })
        : "") +
      scatter(p, rs(seed, "stage-sky"), {
        x0: 20,
        y0: 20,
        x1: 780,
        y1: 220,
        sparkles: 4,
        rings: 3,
        dots: 6,
      }) +
      (column
        ? put(p, seed, column, { x: 120, y: 540, h: 440, key: "column" })
        : "") +
      (speakers
        ? put(p, seed, speakers, { x: 560, y: 548, h: 230, key: "speakers" })
        : "") +
      (mic ? put(p, seed, mic, { x: 420, y: 552, h: 240, key: "mic" }) : "") +
      (light
        ? put(p, seed, light, { x: 10, y: 560, h: 260, key: "light" })
        : "") +
      cloudBank(p, rs(seed, "stage-clouds"), {
        x0: 10,
        x1: 790,
        base: 596,
        top: 520,
        rmin: 22,
        rmax: 36,
        fill: "cloud",
        floating: true,
      })
    )
  },
}

// The templates. Each draws a whole scene from a seed in its own viewBox; a page sizes the format with CSS and the
// SVG is sliced to fill its box, anchored at the bottom, so nothing is measured.
import { city } from "./city"
import { procession, skyline } from "./compositions"
import { observatoryScene, stageScene } from "./compositions-more"
import { arcadeWall, band, doorway, medallion, windowScene } from "./formats"
import { defs } from "./motifs"
import { seedOf } from "./seed"

export type { Scene } from "./scene"

export const TEMPLATES = {
  city,
  window: windowScene,
  medallion,
  band,
  arcade: arcadeWall,
  doorway,
  procession,
  skyline,
  observatory: observatoryScene,
  stage: stageScene,
} as const
export type Template = keyof typeof TEMPLATES

/** Stipple pitch per template, in its own units, for the size it is usually shown at. */
const PITCH: Record<Template, number> = {
  city: 3.2,
  window: 3.4,
  medallion: 2.6,
  band: 3,
  arcade: 3,
  doorway: 2.6,
  procession: 3,
  skyline: 3,
  observatory: 2.8,
  stage: 2.8,
}

export const seedNumber = (seed: string | number) => seedOf(String(seed))
export const pitchOf = (t: Template) => PITCH[t]
export { defs }
